institution: Right to Information Application to CPIO/SPIO
addressee_block:
The Central Public Information Officer (CPIO) / State Public Information Officer (SPIO)
[Department/Ministry Name]
[Office Address]
institution_rules: RTI applications must be addressed to the correct CPIO/SPIO of the public authority. Application fee is Rs. 10/- (rupees ten only) payable by IPO (Indian Postal Order), demand draft, or court fee stamp as prescribed by the authority. Below Poverty Line (BPL) applicants are exempt — attach BPL certificate. State each piece of information sought as a separate numbered point. Do NOT seek opinions, advice, or explanations — only factual information held by the authority. The authority must respond within 30 days (48 hours for life/liberty matters). NEVER invent sections beyond Section 6, 7, and 19 of the RTI Act without verification. For offences and procedures after 1 July 2024, cite the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA) — NOT the repealed IPC 1860, CrPC 1973, or Indian Evidence Act 1872. The Prevention of Corruption Act 1988 and RTI Act 2005 remain in force and may be cited. If unsure of a new-code section number, use [VERIFY].

escalation.addressee_block:
The First Appellate Authority
[Department/Ministry Name]
[Office Address]
escalation.instructions: The statutory 30-day response window under Section 7 has elapsed with no response (or an unsatisfactory response) from the CPIO/SPIO. Draft a First Appeal under Section 19(1) of the RTI Act, 2005, addressed to the First Appellate Authority of the same public authority — not a fresh RTI application. Reference the original application date, reference number if known, and the information originally sought. Request that the Appellate Authority direct the CPIO/SPIO to furnish the information within the time prescribed under Section 19(6). Do not invent a First Appellate Authority name — use [VERIFY: name/designation of First Appellate Authority] if not supplied.
